success_patterns: Each clause was mapped to the one tool whose param names literally carry its qualifiers: `News Network: Get News` with category=business and region=us, a named provider's own endpoint for the email clauses, and the grade-level kanji tool with `grade`=3.

Tools with no params got `[]` for both lists. Clauses with a stated qualifier mapped it to the schema's optional name (`wordLength`=5, `page`=1, `sort-by`=value). Param names were copied verbatim, including the hyphen in `sort-by`.
N distinct emails produced N calls to the same tool, and a separate named-provider clause (disposable check, fake email) got its own call. Nothing was padded and no clause was dropped.
Every answer used the one-object-per-line layout with a single `]` at the end. All four parsed with no bracket or duplicate-key bugs.
The only partial loss was a count inside a clause ('one Hearthstone card from page 1'). The agent emitted `page` but dropped `pageSize`=1, even though the skill states this rule in prose.

patch.reasoning: The batch mostly confirms existing rules (param-fit tool choice, N entities -> N calls, qualifier -> optional, one object per line), so those need no new text. The one concrete loss was dropping `pageSize`=`1` for 'one card from page 1', although the rule is already in the skill as prose. The meta-guidance says prose rules are ineffective and a literal output line to imitate works better, so I replace the Hearthstone sentence with the exact JSON line. I also extend the existing 'sorted by' example with the GamerPower case, because the sort criterion word and the hyphenated param name `sort-by` had to be copied exactly. Both edits replace existing text, so the skill does not grow in rule count.

edits.target: 'One Hearthstone card from page 1' -> ONE call with `page`=`1`, `pageSize`=`1`.
edits.content: 'One Hearthstone card from page 1' -> ONE call where 'one' is also a parameter (page AND pageSize), copy this shape: `{"tool name": "Hearthstone: Get Cards", "required parameters": [], "optional parameters": [{"name": "page", "value": "1"}, {"name": "pageSize", "value": "1"}]}`. Emitting only `page` loses the optional-param score.

'sorted by date' -> the sort field; 'sort all giveaways by their value, highest to lowest' -> `GamerPower: Sort live giveaways` with optional `sort-by`=`value` (the criterion word comes from the query, and the hyphenated param name is copied exactly).
